title: Check Prime Number
statement: Determine if a number is prime.
inputOutputContract: Input integer n; output exactly yes for prime and no otherwise; n<2 is not prime.

mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of isPrime: Treat values below 2 as non-prime and check divisors through the square root.
